result.summary: Workspace deletion deletes the WorkOS organization in the deleter DAG and then emits workspace_deleted with the same workosOrganizationId, causing workos-sync-handler to delete it a second time and fail on WorkOS 404. Mapping 404/entity_not_found in deleteOrganization and treating it as already deleted in deleteOrganizationFromWorkOSUnsafe makes organization deletion idempotent without masking real WorkOS errors.
